text: How many holes does a T-shirt have?
One: four. Two: three. Three: zero.
It has four openings: the collar, the bottom, and two sleeves.
But an opening is not a hole.
Stretch it without tearing. Pull the bottom wide and flatten it.
The collar and the sleeves become three holes.
Holes equal openings minus one. Four minus one: three.
